property_summary: After calling DrugDealer(), the initialized state variable must be true.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the initialized state variable must be true.
After calling DrugDealer(), the initialized state variable must be true.
After a successful call to DrugDealer(), the contract must be marked as initialized (initialized == true).
After a call to DrugDealer() by any address, the ceoAddress state variable should be set to the caller's address.
After any call to DrugDealer(), the caller is the CEO only if the caller is the original CEO address.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the ceoAddress should always be the address that made the call.
After a call to DrugDealer() by any address, the ceoAddress state variable should not be set to the zero address.
After DrugDealer() call, the Kilos balance of the pre-existing referrer (if any) remains unchanged when the caller's referral is already set.
After a collectDrugs call, the referred address (if any) receives exactly one-fifth of the caller's drugsUsed as claimedDrugs.
After collectDrugs is called by a user who already has a referral set to a different address, the referral mapping for that user remains unchanged.
After collectDrugs, the referral mapping of the caller is always either the original ref argument or msg.sender.
After collectDrugs is called, the number of Kilos of any address that was ever a referral (including msg.sender) can only increase or stay the same, not decrease.
The value of Kilos for any address after calling DrugDealer is at least as large as the value before the call.
After calling DrugDealer, the Kilos of any address is unchanged from before the call.

After calling DrugDealer, the claimedDrugs of the referral address is equal to the caller's drugsUsed divided by 5 (zero if no referral) plus the referral's previous claimedDrugs minus the drugs used by the referral to produce kilos.
After any call to DrugDealer(), the claimedDrugs balance of the referral address is equal to its previous value plus one fifth of the drugsUsed (the caller's getMyDrugs() at the time of the call).

After calling DrugDealer(), the sum of claimedDrugs across all addresses equals its previous value plus the caller's drugsUsed minus the drugsUsed divided by 10 added to marketDrugs, and the caller's claimedDrugs is set to 0.
After collectDrugs, claimedDrugs[caller] is less than or equal to drugsUsed before the call, because it should be reset to zero.
After collectDrugs(), the caller's claimedDrugs is always 0.
After collectDrugs(caller), the caller's claimedDrugs value is always 0 for the reference, but may be non-zero for the mutant.
After collectDrugs() returns, claimedDrugs[referral] is exactly drugsUsed/5 added to its previous value.

After two consecutive collectDrugs calls by the same address without any intervening actions that affect claimedDrugs, the caller's claimedDrugs is exactly drugsUsed/5 added to its previous value (since the second call resets to 0 in the reference but to drugsUsed in the mutant).
After calling DrugDealer(), claimedDrugs[any] never decreases, because sellDrugs should reset the caller's claimed drugs to zero, not set them to hasDrugs.
After sellDrugs(), the caller's claimedDrugs should be 0, not equal to the drugs sold.

After a call to sellDrugs(), the total marketDrugs plus the caller's claimedDrugs should be greater than zero if the user had drugs, but in the buggy version the market drugs are increased correctly while the user's claimedDrugs are not reset.
After sellDrugs(), the sum of marketDrugs and the caller's claimedDrugs equals the sum of marketDrugs before the call and the caller's drugs sold.
After sellDrugs(), the caller's claimedDrugs equals 0, not any other value.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the claimedDrugs of a user who never called sellDrugs remains unchanged if they had no drugs to sell.
After a sellDrugs() call, the caller's lastCollect timestamp is not decreased (i.e., the computed time since last collect is bounded by the current timestamp).
The total sum of marketDrugs and all users' claimedDrugs (for a fixed set of users) is invariant across operations that don't involve buying or seeding.
After a call to sellDrugs(), the caller's getMyDrugs() value is zero.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the claimedDrugs balance of any address should not decrease when buyDrugs() is called.
After buying drugs, the buyer's claimedDrugs balance should be greater than before the purchase.
After calling buyDrugs(), the caller's claimedDrugs balance equals the sum of their previous balance plus the drugsBought amount minus the devFee.
After calling buyDrugs() with a given msg.value, the caller's claimedDrugs balance increases by exactly drugsBought minus devFee(drugsBought).
After a call to DrugDealer(), the claimedDrugs balance of the caller should not increase when buyDrugs() is called without an accompanying msg.value.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the lastCollect of any address that was set in getFreeKilo() equals block.timestamp.
The lastCollect mapping for any address is never decremented when getFreeKilo() is called.
After a call to DrugDealer() from any address, marketDrugs remains zero if the market was not seeded.
After calling DrugDealer() from the CEO address, marketDrugs is unchanged from its value before the call.
After calling DrugDealer(), the marketDrugs value equals the value before the call if the market is not seeded (initialized false).
After a call to DrugDealer() from any address, the value of marketDrugs does not change if the market has not been initialized (initialized is false).
After a call to DrugDealer() from any address, the marketDrugs value stays unchanged from its value before the call.
The value of marketDrugs after a collectDrugs call that increases marketDrugs in the reference is reproduced by a post-invocation snapshot invariant.
After calling DrugDealer(), the public state variable marketDrugs must be greater than or equal to its value before the call.
After any sequence of transactions ending with DrugDealer(), the public getter marketDrugs() should be at least the value it had before the call.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the value of marketDrugs returned by the public getter marketDrugs() is the same as before the call.

After a call to DrugDealer() on an initialized contract, the value of marketDrugs returned by the public getter marketDrugs() is increased by an amount equal to drugsUsed/10 (where drugsUsed is the caller's getMyDrugs() at the time of the call).
After a call to collectDrugs(ref) on an initialized contract, the value of marketDrugs returned by the public getter marketDrugs() is at least the value it had before the call.
After a call to collectDrugs(ref), marketDrugs() increases by drugsUsed/10 (where drugsUsed is the caller's getMyDrugs() at call time), independent of any prior actions.
After a call to collectDrugs on an initialized contract, marketDrugs increases by exactly drugsUsed/10, where drugsUsed is the caller's getMyDrugs at call time.
After calling DrugDealer(), marketDrugs should be >= its value before the call.
After calling sellDrugs, the marketDrugs should always be greater than or equal to the previous marketDrugs value (the reference increases it, the buggy version may decrease it).
After sellDrugs, marketDrugs must equal previous marketDrugs plus hasDrugs.
After a call to DrugDealer() that does not revert, the current block timestamp is strictly greater than the previous one, ensuring the drug production rate is positive.
After calling DrugDealer(), the public getter marketDrugs() returns a value that is not less than the recorded value just before the call.
After any sequence of calls ending with a call to DrugDealer(), the value of marketDrugs must be greater than or equal to what it was before the call.
After a call to DrugDealer(), the contract's balance must be greater than or equal to the balance before the call minus any ETH sent in the transaction.
After selling drugs, the contract's balance must increase by the drug value minus the CEO fee.
After any sequence of public calls, if sellDrugs() is called, then marketDrugs must increase by the number of drugs sold.
After any call to DrugDealer(), the value of marketDrugs must remain unchanged.
